entities.name: Crime, Garrison Politics, and the Tivoli Gardens Incursion
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Jamaica grappled with high rates of violent crime linked to garrison politics and the drug trade. The 2010 Tivoli Gardens security operation to extradite drug lord Christopher 'Dudus' Coke resulted in over 70 civilian deaths and prompted national soul-searching about garrison politics.
